name: Sell my home Miami-Dade?

acceptedAnswer.text: Miami-Dade home sellers should start with current comparable sales, local competition, and a review of the property’s condition and distinguishing features. Kelby Contreras helps owners develop and execute a tailored plan for listing, marketing, buyer management, negotiation, and closing.
